title: Time-and-Materials Deposit Calculation — Professional Services Projects
content:
The deposit of a Professional Services Projects time-and-materials statement of work is the class deposit percentage of its estimated fees, rounded half up to the cent, where the estimated fees are the original contract value reduced by the rate discount locked at signature, that is the original contract value multiplied by 100 minus the locked rate discount and divided by 100.

## Definition of the amounts

1. **Estimated fees.** The original contract value multiplied by 100 minus the rate discount locked at signature, divided by 100. The estimated fees are not rounded on their own.
2. **Deposit basis.** The estimated fees.
3. **Deposit percentage.** The deposit percentage of the engagement's class on the billing schedule. The deposit percentage applied is never below 5.0 percent.
4. **Deposit.** The deposit percentage applied once to the deposit basis, rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- Original contract value 60000.00, locked rate discount 7.5 percent, class deposit percentage 25: the estimated fees are 60000.00 multiplied by 92.5 and divided by 100, that is 55500.00; the deposit is 25 percent of 55500.00, that is 13875.00.
- Original contract value 33333.00, locked rate discount 5.0 percent, class deposit percentage 30: the estimated fees are 31666.35; 30 percent of that is 9499.905, and the deposit, rounded half up to the cent at the end, is 9499.91.
